name: new-tab
description: A rounded window with a centered plus for opening a new tab.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Window centerline bounds 7..17 on both axes with corner radius 2.25. The plus uses centered half-extent 1.75 at Regular 1.75. Natural Filled uses the matching window exterior bounds 6.125..17.875 / radius 3.125 and the exact Regular plus as a transparent counter. No top divider crowds the small native drawing. Even at Bold, the plus and inner window border remain separated by .75px. The rounded window retains more than .48px Circle clearance at Bold. All None/Square/Circle forms use the identical native glyph position and size, without per-frame transforms. Outline defaults to Regular 1.75 with round caps/joins, Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10; Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with corner radius 3.125 / Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. Original project geometry; no third-party SVG paths used. All forms remain drafts pending owner review. CURRENT FRAME NONE ENLARGEMENT: the owner requested larger standalone icons while preserving the existing framed glyphs. The preceding shared None/frame size rule is superseded for this identity. Scale native Outline geometry uniformly about12,12 by 1.825 but keep Regular1.75 and round-cap radius.875 fixed. Rebuild Filled from the enlarged centerlines with fixed.875 expansion; do not scale Filled thickness or apply an SVG transform. Visible Regular exterior bounds are2..22 on both axes, centered at12,12. Square/Circle source SVGs and metadata are intentionally unchanged and retain the earlier smaller native framed glyph. All revised standalone drawings remain drafts pending owner review. CURRENT NO-FRAME POLICY: the owner explicitly removed Square and Circle variants for this identity. Only Frame None is supported; prior notes about framed glyphs and frame clearance are historical. Preserve the enlarged standalone size and fixed Regular1.75 stroke. Standalone geometry is unchanged by this frame removal.

review.note: Owner requested no frame variants. Standalone result awaits visual review.
